name: Ray-box intersection
definition: A method for determining if a ray intersects an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) by treating the box as the intersection of three pairs of parallel planes (slabs). It computes the entry (tnear) and exit (tfar) distances for each slab pair.
summary: Ray-box intersection determines if a ray hits an axis-aligned bounding box by treating it as intersecting slabs, exploiting axis alignment for efficient scalar comparisons.
